I am not alone in my quest for magic. In villages throughout the world I have seen other practitioners peddling their wares. Each one seems to specialize in different facets of magic, from general magic, to weaving magic into the air, to smithing powerful runes to enchant gear.

In terms of currency, I have seen them ask for Quicksilver, so I should stock up on that before making the journey to trade. 

I'm certain I can complete my studies without their help if I needed to though.
